每个工程最多 100 个会话，请在历史列表中删除不再需要的记录: Each project supports up to 100 conversations. Delete unneeded records in conversation history.
请先停止这个会话的任务，再归档: Stop this conversation's task before archiving it
请先填写 Base URL 和模型 ID: Enter a Base URL and model ID first
请先应用或放弃当前方案，再开始下一次修改: Apply or discard the current proposal before starting another edit
一次任务最多启用 8 个 Skill，请先调整选择: Enable no more than 8 Skills per task
工程已切换，请重新生成方案: The project has changed. Generate a new proposal.
依据当前主题创建页面: Create a page using the current theme
参考当前工程主题和 Skill，新建一个菜单。先与我确认用途和实际业务内容。: Create a menu using this project's theme and Skills. Confirm its purpose and real business requirements with me first.
优化选中组件或当前页面: Improve the selection or current page
优化当前选中组件；没有选中组件时优化当前页面。改善布局、对齐和可读性，保持现有功: Improve the selected component, or the current page if none is selected. Refine layout, alignment and readability while preserving functionality and style.
读取当前页面与问题列表，修复能够确定的配置错误，保留其他功能。: Read the current page and issue list. Fix confirmed configuration errors while preserving other functionality.
解释当前选中组件的结构、变量和交互；没有选中组件时解释当前页面。此次不修改文件。: Explain the selected component's structure, variables and interactions, or the current page if none is selected. Do not modify files.
检查当前页面和模板用到的语言键，补齐 zh_cn 与 en_us，保持占位符一致: Check translation keys used by this page and its templates. Complete zh_cn and en_us while preserving placeholders.
请先打开画布，再附加预览: Open the canvas before attaching its preview
无法读取拖入资源: Could not read the dropped asset
当前还有未应用方案，清空对话并放弃方案？: A proposal is still pending. Clear the conversation and discard it?
展开 Agent 浮窗: Expand Agent into a floating window
将选中组件加入本次需求: Attach the selected component to this request
描述需求，或拖入资源…（/ 快捷操作）: Describe your idea or drop assets here… (/ shortcuts)
从资源库选择图片: Choose an image from the asset library
将所选图片发送给支持视觉的模型；关闭后只发送资源引用: Send selected images to a vision-capable model; disable to send references only
按需读取工程 · 修改先预览: Reads files as needed · Review changes first
Agent 已在浮窗中打开: Agent is open in a floating window
原配置已变更，请查看差异后重新生成。: The original configuration has changed. Review the diff and regenerate.
应用后可撤销，保存后才会写入磁盘: You can undo after applying. Changes reach disk only when saved.
根据文本、工具和图片估算；不同模型分词会有差异。: Estimated from text, tools and images. Tokenization varies by model.
最近一次模型请求报告的输入与输出用量。: Input and output usage reported by the latest model request.
发送后显示上下文用量。: Context usage appears after sending a request.
选中画布组件、拖入资源，: Select a canvas component, drop an asset,
或直接描述你想做的菜单。: or describe the menu you want to make.
参考当前主题，新建一个有左侧导航和右侧内容的菜单。先读取现有规范，内容未知时向我: Create a menu with left navigation and right content using the current theme. Read existing guidelines first and ask me about any unknown content.
优化当前选中组件的布局与可读性，保持现有功能和主题一致。: Improve the selected component's layout and readability while retaining its functionality and theme.
检查当前菜单及引用的模板，修复尺寸、语言键和交互配置中能够确定的问题。: Inspect the current menu and referenced templates. Fix confirmed size, translation-key and interaction issues.
模型列表已读取，可选择或填写自定义 ID: Model list loaded. Select a model or enter a custom ID.
{0}；也可以直接填写模型 ID: {0}; you can also enter the model ID manually
使用自己的服务地址和模型。设置保存在本机，与菜单工程分开。: Use your own service endpoint and model. Settings are stored locally, separately from menu projects.
留空保留已保存密钥: Leave blank to keep the saved key
输入自己的 API Key；本地模型可留空: Enter your API key; local services may allow an empty key
填写服务商提供的模型 ID: Enter the model ID provided by your service
在此设备加密保存密钥: Save the key encrypted on this device
按服务商文档填写上下文上限；接近阈值时会自动整理摘要，聊天记录仍完整保留。输出会: Set the context limit from your provider's documentation. Older context is summarized near the threshold while the full chat is retained. Output reserves up to 20% of context.
思考内容取决于模型接口。Responses 可请求摘要；兼容接口返回 reaso: Reasoning depends on the API. Responses may return a summary; reasoning_content and Anthropic thinking_delta are streamed when provided. Studio does not invent reasoning.
删除“{0}”的本地会话记录？菜单文件会保留。: Delete the local conversation “{0}”? Menu files will be kept.
把菜单规范、设计规则和配置参考交给 Agent。可添加多个 Skill；导入同名: Give Agent menu conventions, design rules and configuration references. Import multiple Skills; importing the same name updates it and retains the previous version.
启用的 Skill 在任务开始时加载；更新会用于下一次任务。包内说明、参考和配置: Enabled Skills load when a task starts; updates apply to the next task. Instructions, references and configurations can be read. Scripts do not run automatically.
